Amulet of Natural Armor
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 256, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 500
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th
Slot neck; Price 2,000 gp ( +1), 8,000 gp ( +2), 18,000 gp ( +3), 32,000 gp ( +4), 50,000 gp ( +5); Weight —
Description
This amulet, usually containing some type of magically preserved monster hide or other natural armor—such as bone, horn, carapace, or beast scales— toughens the wearer’s body and flesh, giving him an enhancement bonus to his natural armor from +1 to +5, depending on the kind of amulet.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, creator's caster level must be at least three times the amulet's bonus; Cost 1,000 gp (+1), 4,000 gp (+2), 9,000 gp (+3), 16,000 gp (+4), 25,000 gp (+5)
